title: Authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the GlobalProtect™ portal and gateway of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software…
description: CVE-2026-0328 is an authentication bypass vulnerability in the GlobalProtect portal and gateway of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software. This flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass security controls and establish an unauthorized VPN connection. Other Palo Alto products such as Panorama, Cloud NGFW, and Prisma Access are not affected. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7. No fixed versions or patches are currently specified in the available data.
